records.name: What Is Going On?
records.objectives_text: Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess Moira Bronzebeard's kidnapping. Take that information to Thrall in Orgrimmar. You recall Gor'shak mentioning that Kharan is being held in a cell nearby.

records.name: The Eastern Kingdoms
records.objectives_text: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.

records.name: The Royal Rescue
records.objectives_text: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.

records.name: The Princess Saved?
records.objectives_text: Return to Thrall!

records.name: Aquementas
records.objectives_text: Take the Book of Aquor, the Silvery Claws, and the Irontree Heart to Marshal's Refuge. Use the Book of Aquor to summon Aquementas. After you have the completed totem, take it to J.D. Collie in Marshal's Refuge.

records.name: Counterattack!
records.objectives_text: Bring a Piece of Krom'zar's Banner to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.

records.name: A Taste of Flame
records.objectives_text: Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth. You have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.

records.name: A Taste of Flame
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar. You only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence. Return the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.

prerequisites.wiki_text: A Taste of Flame or A Taste of Flame (2)

records.name: The Rise of the Machines
records.objectives_text: Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania. You recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.

records.name: The Rise of the Machines
records.objectives_text: Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus. You recall Theodora saying that Lotwil was stationed in a camp to the east.

records.name: The Rise of the Machines
records.objectives_text: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.

records.name: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
records.objectives_text: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors! Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.

wiki.page: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves

records.name: KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials
records.objectives_text: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors! Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.

wiki.page: KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials

records.name: The Spectral Chalice
records.objectives_text: The spectral chalice floats in the air, slowing rising and falling... as if to the beat of a dying heart.

records.name: Silver Heart
records.objectives_text: Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart for Eridan Bluewind in Felwood.

records.name: Cleansing Felwood
records.objectives_text: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Arathandris Silversky in .

records.name: Cleansing Felwood
records.objectives_text: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Maybess Riverbreeze in .

records.name: The Strength of Corruption
records.objectives_text: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas wants you to kill 12 Angerclaw Grizzlies and 12 Felpaw Ravagers in Felwood.

records.name: Precarious Predicament
records.objectives_text: Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through Burning Steppes and through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody. You will also be required to hand over your Thorium Shackles to Lexlort.

records.name: Grark Lorkrub
records.objectives_text: Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress. When you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.

records.name: The Heart of the Mountain
records.objectives_text: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

records.name: The Missing Courier
records.objectives_text: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

records.name: Hurley Blackbreath
records.objectives_text: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.

records.name: Boat Wreckage
records.objectives_text: Return to Feathermoon Stronghold and show Ginro Hearthkindle the Discarded Knife you have found.

records.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
records.objectives_text: Speak with Ragnar Thunderbrew.

records.name: The Knife Revealed
records.objectives_text: Take the Discarded Knife to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

records.name: Psychometric Reading
records.objectives_text: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

records.name: The Woodpaw Gnolls
records.objectives_text: Search the Woodpaw Gnoll camps of southern Feralas for evidence of the courier's belongings or the courier himself.

records.name: Operation: Death to Angerforge
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.

records.name: Vivian Lagrave
records.objectives_text: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

records.name: Lost Thunderbrew Recipe
records.objectives_text: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

records.name: The Writhing Deep
records.objectives_text: Now that Raschal's last known whereabouts have been discovered, continue your search for him or his remains in the Writhing Deep. According to the note, it is located to the south of the Woodpaw gnoll camps.

records.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
records.objectives_text: Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

records.name: Muigin and Larion
records.objectives_text: Collect 15 Bloodpetals and return to Muigin.

records.name: A Visit to Gregan
records.objectives_text: Take a Bloodpetal to Gregan Brewspewer in Feralas.

records.name: Haze of Evil
records.objectives_text: Collect 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze, then return to Muigin in Un'Goro Crater.

records.name: Bloodpetal Sprouts
records.objectives_text: Collect 3 Bloodpetal Sprouts for Muigin.

records.name: Larion and Muigin
records.objectives_text: Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers, and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.

records.name: Zapper Fuel
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.

records.name: Marvon's Workshop
records.objectives_text: Travel to Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

records.name: Bloodpetal Zapper
records.objectives_text: For the zapper to work, it needs a sample of the target creature. Head out into the crater and collect a Bloodpetal Sprout. Then I can calibrate it to work on Muigin's little friends... If he weren't so stubborn, we could be on our way home, already... But until then, I'll just have to show him that his little prank doesn't bother me at all!

records.name: Recipe of the Kaldorei
records.objectives_text: Collect 7 Small Spider Legs for Zarrin in Dolanaar.

records.name: Goblin Engineering
records.objectives_text: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

records.name: Dragonkin Menace
records.objectives_text: Slay 15 Black Broodlings, 10 Black Dragonspawn, 4 Black Wyrmkin and 1 Black Drake. Return to Helendis Riverhorn when the task is complete.

records.name: The True Masters
records.objectives_text: Travel to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn's Letter to Magistrate Solomon.

records.name: The True Masters
records.objectives_text: Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. Bolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.

records.name: The True Masters
records.objectives_text: Speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon after speaking with Lady Katrana Prestor.

records.name: The True Masters
records.objectives_text: Take Bolvar's Decree to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

records.name: The Love Potion
records.objectives_text: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.

records.name: The True Masters
records.objectives_text: Speak with Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes.

records.name: The True Masters
records.objectives_text: Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor's fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task. You recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for him in a cave to the north.

records.name: Marshal Windsor
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Mountain in the northwest and enter Blackrock Depths. Find out what became of Marshal Windsor. You recall Ragged John talking about Windsor being dragged off to a prison.

records.name: Abandoned Hope
records.objectives_text: Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.

records.name: Chasing A-Me 01
records.objectives_text: Find A-Me 01 in .

records.name: Chasing A-Me 01
records.objectives_text: Find a Mithril Casing and return to A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.

records.name: Chasing A-Me 01
records.objectives_text: Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel in Un'Goro Crater.

objectives.text: Protect A-Me 01 until you reach Karna Remtravel

records.name: Ancient Spirit
records.objectives_text: Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern Ashenvale.

records.name: Overmaster Pyron
records.objectives_text: Slay Overmaster Pyron and return to Jalinda Sprig. You recall Jalinda talking about Pyron guarding the quarry. Perhaps you should search there?

records.name: Incendius!
records.objectives_text: Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!

records.name: A Crumpled Up Note
records.objectives_text: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.

records.name: Freed from the Hive
records.objectives_text: Free Raschal from the Zukk'ash hive. Return to Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold and let him know that Raschal is alive and well.

records.name: A Hero's Welcome
records.objectives_text: Speak with Shandris Feathermoon in Feathermoon Stronghold.

records.name: Rise of the Silithid
records.objectives_text: Bring Raschal's Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.

records.name: Thalanaar Delivery
records.objectives_text: Bring the Undelivered Parcel to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar.

records.name: A Shred of Hope
records.objectives_text: Return Marshal Windsor's Lost Information. Marshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge.

objectives.text: Marshal Windsor's Lost Information (from General Angerforge)
Marshal Windsor's Lost Information (from Golem Lord Argelmach)

records.name: FIFTY! YEP!
records.objectives_text: Oralius wants 50 Blackrock Medallions. Chances are high that these medallions can be found on the orcs in the Burning Steppes.

records.name: The Good Stuff
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.

records.name: The Bait for Lar'korwi
records.objectives_text: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

records.name: A Sample of Slime...
records.objectives_text: Gather Felwood Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Felwood. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most corrupt. Bring 5 of the Corrupted Felwood Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

records.name: ... and a Batch of Ooze
records.objectives_text: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

records.name: Tablet of the Seven
records.objectives_text: Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

records.name: Food for Baby
records.objectives_text: Bring 5 Silvermane Stalker Flanks to Agnar Beastamer in Hinterlands.

records.name: Becoming a Parent
records.objectives_text: Speak to Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands.

records.name: The Mighty U'cha
records.objectives_text: Bring U'cha's Pelt to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

records.name: Making Sense of It
records.objectives_text: Speak with J.D. Collie in a moment.

records.name: Jail Break!
records.objectives_text: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.

records.name: Get those Hyenas!!!
records.objectives_text: Bring 7 Spotted Hyena Pelts to TESTTAUREN at Freewind Post.

records.name: Yuka Screwspigot
records.objectives_text: Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

records.name: Kharan Mighthammer
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer. The King mentioned that Kharan was being held prisoner there - perhaps you should try looking for a prison.

records.name: Kharan's Tale
records.objectives_text: Listen as Kharan Mighthammer tells his story.

records.name: The Bearer of Bad News
records.objectives_text: Return to Ironforge and deliver the bad news to King Magni Bronzebeard.

records.name: The Fate of the Kingdom
records.objectives_text: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

records.name: The Princess's Surprise
records.objectives_text: Return to Ironforge and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard.

records.name: Felbound Ancients
records.objectives_text: Travel to Darnassus and use Eridan's Vial to collect a Vial of Blessed Water from the Temple of the Moon. Return to Eridan with the filled vial.

records.name: Purified!
records.objectives_text: Speak to Eridan again in a moment.

records.name: Caught!
records.objectives_text: Kill 8 Dark Iron Geologists and bring 15 pieces of Silk Cloth to the person locked in the outhouse in Searing Gorge.

records.name: Ledger from Tanaris
records.objectives_text: Take the copy of Goodsteel's Ledger and then find the items listed in it before seeking Krinkle Goodsteel in Tanaris.

records.name: The Key to Freedom
records.objectives_text: Search Searing Gorge and find a use for the Grimesilt Outhouse Key you have found.

records.name: Summon Felsteed
records.objectives_text: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet to learn the ability to summon a Felsteed.

records.objectives_text: Find Iverron by the cave to the north.

records.objectives_text: Kill 10 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.

records.name: Volcanic Activity
records.objectives_text: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.

records.name: Super Sticky
records.objectives_text: Collect 12 samples of Super Sticky Tar for Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.

records.name: Well of Corruption
records.objectives_text: Collect a sample of corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell and bring it to Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post.

records.name: Corrupted Sabers
records.objectives_text: Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moon well, release it, then bring it back to Winna. Once you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.

objectives.text: Return the corrupted cat to Winna Hazzard

records.name: Pawn Captures Queen
records.objectives_text: Defeat the Gorishi Hive Queen once she is summoned.

records.name: Calm Before the Storm
records.objectives_text: Bring the Bank Voucher to Karus in the bank of Orgrimmar.

records.objectives_text: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.

records.name: Seal of Ascension
records.objectives_text: Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan. The Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn; Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone; and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.

records.name: Seal of Ascension
records.objectives_text: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken. It is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the Orb of Draconic Energy on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties. Control the beast and force the Flames of the B

records.objectives_text: Speak with Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.

records.name: The Cliffspring River
records.objectives_text: Travel north of Auberdine to the first waterfall along the Cliffspring River and draw a sample from the pool there. Return to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine with the Cliffspring River Sample.

records.name: The Blackwood Corrupted
records.objectives_text: Fill the Empty Cleansing Bowl at the Auberdine Moonwell. Gather a sample of fruit, nut, and grain from the northern Blackwood furbolg camps. Mix the bowl and place it near the bonfire closest to the Cliffspring River at the northern camp, thus summoning the satyr corruptor. Take the Talisman of Corruption and bring it to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.

records.objectives_text: Bring Doomrigger's Clasp to Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.

records.name: Strange Sources
records.objectives_text: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.

records.name: Enraged Wildkin
records.objectives_text: Locate Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked camp and supplies in southern Winterspring.

records.name: En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler. By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.

records.name: Enraged Wildkin
records.objectives_text: Find Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked wagon.

records.name: Enraged Wildkin
records.objectives_text: Pick up Jaron's Supplies from the snow, then find the wildkin that stole the amulet that Jaron spoke of. Bring Jaron's Supplies and the Blue-featherd Amulet to Jaron Stoneshaper at the lodge in Winterspring.

records.name: Serpent Wild
records.objectives_text: Report your findings to Motega Firemane.

records.name: Mother's Milk
records.objectives_text: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.

records.name: Urok Doomhowl
records.objectives_text: Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.

records.name: Protect Kanati Greycloud
records.objectives_text: Protect Kanati Greycloud from the centaur attack.

records.name: Guarding Secrets
records.objectives_text: Take the Blue-Feathered Necklace to Trull Failbane at Bloodvenom Post.

records.name: Guarding Secrets
records.objectives_text: Take the Blue-Feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.

records.name: Warlord's Command
records.objectives_text: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.

records.name: Free At Last
records.objectives_text: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.

objectives.text: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle.

records.name: Further Corruption
records.objectives_text: Eridan Bluewind in wants you to kill 8 Jadefire Hellcallers, 8 Jadefire Betrayers, 8 Jadefire Tricksters, and Xavaric. Return to Eridan when the task is completed.

records.name: Tinkee Steamboil
records.objectives_text: Speak with Tinkee Steamboil.

records.name: Lost in Battle
records.objectives_text: Find Mankrik's wife and then return to him in the Crossroads.

records.name: Eitrigg's Wisdom
records.objectives_text: Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall. You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.

records.name: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
records.objectives_text: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.

wiki.page: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil

records.name: Shard of a Felhound
records.objectives_text: Take the :Felhas Ruby and use it on one of the Felhounds found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Felhas Ruby and the :Imprisoned Felhound Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

records.name: Shard of an Infernal
records.objectives_text: Take the Infus Emerald and use it on one of the Infernals found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Infus Emerald and the Imprisoned Infernal Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

records.name: The Completed Orb of Dar'Orahil
records.objectives_text: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the :Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.

objectives.text: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete your item

records.objectives_text: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

records.name: A Matter of Time
records.objectives_text: Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites. Slay 10 Temporal Parasites, and then return the Temporal Displacer to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Counting Out Time
records.objectives_text: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city. Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: For The Horde!
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.

records.name: The Completed Orb of Noh'Orahil
records.objectives_text: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the :Orb of Noh'Orahil and then speak to her again.

objectives.text: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete your item

records.name: Returning the Cleansed Orb
records.objectives_text: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

records.name: Operative Bijou
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.

records.name: Bijou's Belongings
records.objectives_text: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.

records.name: Bijou's Reconnaissance Report
records.objectives_text: Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.

records.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
records.objectives_text: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

records.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
records.objectives_text: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.
